text.en: Pair the reference and blurred candidate on the same three-dimensional grid, using gain one.
text.zh: 在同一三维网格上比较参考体和高斯模糊结果，强度系数为一。

text.en: Compute positive local contrast by subtracting a 0.4 millimetre Gaussian background.
text.zh: 减去 0.4 毫米高斯平滑背景，保留正的局部对比度。

text.en: Use only the reference to identify tubular support, then split it into weak and strong contrast groups.
text.zh: 仅从参考体建立管状结构区域，按参考对比度中位数分为弱、强两组。

text.en: Measure shared contrast in each group. Q is 100 times the geometric mean of the two overlap scores.
text.zh: 分别累计两组的共有对比度，Q 等于两组重叠分数几何平均值的 100 倍。

text.en: Q complements PSNR, full-image SSIM and L1. The three controls retain background and structural changes separately.
text.zh: Q 补充 PSNR、全图 SSIM 和 L1，分别反映结构保留与整体一致性。
小鼠实例：从 GT 提取局部背景与正对比度。
text.en: Measured mouse: extract the local background and positive contrast from GT.

text.zh: 使用 GT 确定的弱、强结构区域，评价待评估图像。
text.en: Evaluate the test image on the weak and strong support defined by GT.

text.zh: 在三维体中累计两组的共有对比度，得到结构重叠分数。
text.en: Accumulate shared contrast in both groups throughout the 3D volume to obtain the overlap scores.
Measured mouse result: Dweak = 0.7872, Dstrong = 0.8654, Q = 82.53.
